fields.name: add_remote_addr
fields.description: Adds a REMOTE_ADDR field to the record. The value of REMOTE_ADDR is the client's address, which is extracted from the X-Forwarded-For header.

fields.name: buffer_chunk_size
fields.description: This sets the chunk size for incoming JSON messages. These chunks are then stored and managed in the space available by buffer_max_size. Compatibility alias for http_server.buffer_chunk_size.

fields.name: buffer_max_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum buffer size to receive a JSON message. Compatibility alias for http_server.buffer_max_size.

fields.name: http2
fields.description: Enable HTTP/2 support. Compatibility alias for http_server.http2.

fields.name: http_server.workers
fields.description: Number of HTTP listener worker threads.

fields.name: oauth2.allowed_audience
fields.description: Audience claim to enforce when validating incoming OAuth 2.0 JWT tokens.

fields.name: oauth2.allowed_clients
fields.description: Authorized client_id or azp claim values. Can be specified multiple times.

fields.name: oauth2.issuer
fields.description: Expected issuer (iss) claim. Required when oauth2.validate is true.

fields.name: oauth2.jwks_refresh_interval
fields.description: How often in seconds to refresh the cached JWKS keys from oauth2.jwks_url.

fields.name: oauth2.jwks_url
fields.description: JWKS endpoint URL used to fetch public keys for JWT validation. Required when oauth2.validate is true.

fields.name: oauth2.validate
fields.description: Enable OAuth 2.0 JWT validation for incoming requests.

fields.name: port
fields.description: The port for Fluent Bit to listen on.

fields.name: remote_addr_key
fields.description: Key name for the remote address field added to the record when add_remote_addr is enabled.

fields.name: success_header
fields.description: Add an HTTP header key/value pair on success. Multiple headers can be set. For example, X-Custom custom-answer.

fields.name: successful_response_code
fields.description: Allows setting successful response code. Supported values: 200, 201, and 204.

fields.name: tag_key
fields.description: Specify the key name to overwrite a tag. If set, the tag will be overwritten by a value of the key.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own thread.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.
